messages:
alisa: Quick UX flag: on staging the p95 marker flickers when I toggle sampling while dragging the scrubber. It moves off the thumb for a frame and then snaps back. Repro: 4h range, Sampling toggle -> On/Off while holding drag. Screenshot: https://staging.redwood.ai/snap/flicker-2198765432.png

ben: I can repro. Looks like we recalc bucket widths synchronously on sampling toggles which reflows the layout mid-drag.

rita: UX question: should sampling toggles be allowed during an active drag? Maybe disable toggles or show a small toast "Finish scrub to change sampling"?

mark: Prefer not to block. Better: keep the p95 marker in a separate overlay layer so bucket reflow doesn't affect it. Render bucket changes behind an opacity layer and crossfade.

alisa: Agree on overlay. Also the p95 tooltip jumps to top-left sometimes when nodes remount. That needs throttling.

a11y-bot: Accessibility: when the marker flickers we lose focus and SR users miss updates. Add tabindex=0 on the marker, aria-live="polite" region for p95 text, and ensure focus ring persists during transform animations. Use full words for units in announcements.

ben: Implementation plan: 1) Render marker + scrubber thumb in a fixed overlay using translate3d, 2) keep bucket DOM mounted and animate opacity for new/old sets, 3) throttle tooltip reposition to 100ms. Low-risk and reversible.

rita: Microcopy: change toggle label from 'Sampling' to 'Sampling — approximate results' when on, and 'Sampling — exact results' when off. Hover text: "Sampling approximates percentiles for very large ranges to reduce compute. Disable for exact numbers." Avoid parentheses and abbreviations.

a11y-bot: For screen readers prefer 'Sampling on: approximate results' and 'Sampling off: exact results' so the word 'approximate' is explicit. Announce when user toggles sampling: "Sampling turned off. Results are exact."

mark: PR coming with overlay + opacity fade + aria-live node. Will also add a11y announcements on toggle. Will keep virtualization unchanged to avoid risky refactors.

deploy-bot: Preview built: https://staging.redwood.ai/heatmap/preview/2198765432 (includes overlay + ARIA updates).

alisa: Quick test on VoiceOver+Chrome: overlay stops flicker, aria-live announces p95 when scrubbing, but tooltip reposition still jumps sometimes on very fast scrubs.

ben: I'll add a short debounce to tooltip reposition (100ms) and ensure transform updates happen without reflow. Also add a small CSS fade (120ms) for bucket swaps.

rita: Accessibility nit: when user uses keyboard arrow to scrub, announce step size and new p95: e.g., "Scrub step: one minute. Chart percentiles: p95 one hundred eighty milliseconds." Add a small inline control to set scrub step (1m/5m/15m). Default depends on range.

a11y-bot: Recommendation accepted. Ensure step control exposes full wording (no '1m') and supports Shift+arrow for accelerated scrub (announce 'Accelerated scrub: ten minutes').

mark: Updated PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/10211  overlay, opacity fade, aria-live updates, scrub-step control. Dev preview link above updated. CI green.

deploy-bot: Deployed patch to staging for broader QA.

alisa: QA: Flicker gone for most cases. Tooltip still misplaces if scrubber is released during a bucket swap; probably ordering issue. Filing a small follow-up ticket.

rita: Changelog suggestion: "Heatmap: stabilize p95 marker during sampling toggles and scrubbing; added scrub-step control and improved screen-reader announcements."

ben: Follow-up ticket created: HD-4321 "Tooltip reposition edge-case when releasing scrub during bucket crossfade". We'll pick up next sprint.

alisa: Thanks team. This feels much smoother. :clap:
